content.rendered: Practice Profile Architecture Matters is a medium-sized North Melbourne-based architectural practice with a focus on residential, commercial, aged care and retirement homes and a wide array of municipal projects. We engage in detailed consultative and collaborative design processes to tailor our designs to the needs of a project’s owners, as well those of a building’s occupants and users and often the broader community. The office currently comprises seven staff, including the two director architects, Anthony Quigley and Anthony Gionfriddo.
